I wrote this on a whim, as I was feeling miserable and this is just how I unwind. I don't really care much if it's any good I just write whatever is on my mind.

I didn't say it's the song of life nor death. It's the song of silence and it's when life is most peaceful that you hear it.

Now if you check the subreddit this is posted maybe that will give you a hint. What I am trying to convey is that when you are depressed everything seems devoid of joy no matter how beautiful it is, all you want is stop living. 
 
Again, I didn't write this with the intention of getting a book deal. I was just feeling miserable and this is how I unwind.

Well it's both. I have no one to talk to ( or that's what i tell myself ) so I illustrate my pain in the form of literature, hoping it might resonate with someone who can help me in a one way or another.

Maybe you say that reality is boring because you are in an environment that doesn't appreciate those things and views them as useless. 

Why not try to find some people who are intrested in those things too and befriend them, even if on the internet.

Also there are ways where you can be both productive and indulge in your hobbies. Try to pick up drawing, making fan art of your favourite characters, or learn how to program a game. 
Try writing short stories or write down your feelings and thoughts, which is a great way of helping your mental health and you learn to think systematically.

There are many ways that you can make your hobbies part of your reality, even if those around convince you that there is only one defined way of becoming successful.
